subject: Acme pen-test: report request, scope clarifications, and remediation routing
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-security.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial pen-test deliverables and scope confirmation

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for engaging Acme Security for the external penetration test. We have completed our fieldwork and have a draft of the findings and scope notes attached (acme_pt_draft.pdf). Before we finalize the full report and the executive summary, we need a couple items from your side so that we can complete the deliverable package: 

- Confirmation of in-scope endpoints (public API endpoints and the console at console.redwood.com) and any IP ranges you excluded during testing.
- A copy (or link) to your internal vulnerability tracker/export so we can reference ticket IDs in our remediation recommendations.
- List of remediation owners for any critical/high findings so we can include names in the remediation plan.

Deadline: we are planning to issue the final report by 2026-11-18; if we don't get the above artifacts by end of day 2026-11-12 it will delay the final delivery by ~1 week.

Attached: acme_pt_draft.pdf (executive draft)

Happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Cheers,
Jane
Senior Tester, Acme Security
Acme Security, Inc.
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Initial pen-test deliverables and scope confirmation

Team — forwarding vendor draft + asks from Acme. TL;DR: they need 1) the confirmed scope list (public API + console), 2) our vuln tracker export and 3) remediation owners for the high/critical items. They will finalize the report by 11/18 if we provide artifacts by 11/12.

Action items:
- Evelyn: please pull the vuln tracker export and a one-page remediation matrix (owner, ETA, status) for high/critical findings. Attach as CSV/PDF so vendor can reference ticket IDs.
- Markus: please identify engineering owners for the critical items + confirm whether any items are already mitigated by recent config changes. If you can add Jira keys to the matrix that would be ideal.
- Dev: once Markus assigns owners, can you confirm the estimated remediation ETA for the items you'll own?

I want to avoid delaying the vendor final report — can we get the export and matrix by EOD 11/11? If that's tight, set expectations and propose an alternative.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Initial pen-test deliverables and scope confirmation

Monica — assigning this as Security lead. Quick status: we have consolidated the vendor draft against our tracker and created a remediation matrix. See attached: redwood_pen_test_summary_v3.pdf and vuln_tracker_export.csv. Highlights below (summary for high/critical only):

- CRITICAL-1: unauthenticated access to metrics endpoint (public-api.metrics.redwood.com) — owner: markus_klein, status: pending mitigation, ETA: 2026-11-18, Jira: SUP-1984.
- HIGH-2: token leakage in debug logs under verbose mode — owner: dev_patel, status: in progress (mitigation: reduce logging and rotate affected tokens), ETA: 2026-11-13, Jira: SUP-1999.
- HIGH-3: outdated dependency in inference-serving that may allow RCE in a narrow path — owner: eng infra, status: scheduled patch, ETA: 2026-11-20, Jira: SUP-2007.

Notes: the tracker export includes internal ticket IDs and the risk rating we use for SOC 2 evidence. I also added a short note for the vendor clarifying the scope: public API endpoints (api.redwood.com and associated domains), console.redwood.com, and all managed inference endpoints. We explicitly excluded our internal-only admin VPCs (per procurement/legal request) — I copied the IP ranges excluded in the CSV.

Next steps: Evelyn will provide the two attachments to Acme and request they reference our Jira keys in the final report. Markus / Dev — please confirm the status and any blockers below.

Attachments: redwood_pen_test_summary_v3.pdf, vuln_tracker_export.csv

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Initial pen-test deliverables and scope confirmation

Thanks Evelyn. I created the Jira tickets for the critical/high items and linked them to the remediation matrix: SUP-1984 (metrics auth fix), SUP-1999 (log token rotation), SUP-2007 (dependency patch). Action items for engineering: 

- Dev Patel: take SUP-1999 (token in debug logs). Please push the log-level change to canary and rotate the impacted tokens. Provide PR link and verification steps. ETA: 11/13 COB.
- Infra: take SUP-2007 — scheduling patch for 11/20 deploy window.
- Myself: will own SUP-1984; plan to add an auth gate and update the metrics proxy config. I expect a PR by 11/16 and deploy by 11/18 (coord with SRE).

I attached a short notes file (patch_notes.md) with the proposed config change and a test checklist. Evelyn: once PRs are merged, please mark status in the matrix.

Markus
Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Initial pen-test deliverables and scope confirmation

Ack — I will take SUP-1999. Quick notes:
- I will implement the logging change and push a canary PR by EOD 11/12. PR will include steps to reproduce the original signal and post-mitigation verification.
- Token rotation: need a list of affected tokens/clients (Evelyn, please confirm which tokens to expire).
- Need access to the vuln tracker export (I have access but the export CSV sent to vendor is helpful for cross-referencing).

I will update SUP-1999 with PR link and ETA once PR is created.

— Dev
Senior Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Acme pen-test: report request, scope clarifications, and remediation routing

Team — great progress and thanks for the fast turnaround. Summary / next steps for external delivery: 

- Evelyn to send redwood_pen_test_summary_v3.pdf and vuln_tracker_export.csv to Acme by 11/15 EOD and ask them to reference our Jira keys in the final report.
- Markus and Dev to update Jira tickets with PR links and verification steps. Target: PRs open by 11/16, merges per owners' timelines.
- Security will mark SOC 2 evidence folder with the finalized remediation matrix and artifacts after vendor finalizes report (Drive folder link below).

Scheduling: let's run a 30-min sync Wednesday 11/17 10:00 AM PT to confirm all merges and to prepare the SOC 2 evidence pack. I'll invite Sean from CS to help with any customer-facing comms.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-soc2-evidence

Thanks all — please update the thread when your action items are complete.

Monica Patel
